plates.caption: One of five models that named all three flagged items and declined to treat them as established.

plates.caption: Self-identifies as Grok 4.5 against a table naming Grok 4.6, and names the three flagged items. Answered in Fast mode.

plates.title: Run 07 · Claude Opus 5
plates.caption: The introspection answer, the conflict-of-interest disclosure, and the “it is not an instrument” line. Answered at High effort; AA scores the Max row.

plates.title: Run 08 · Qwen3.7-Plus
plates.caption: The hedged assertion that the named models do not exist — “This strongly suggests these names are hypothetical…” — quoted in full after Correction Nine restored the hedge.

plates.title: Run 09 · Venice, running Kimi K2.5
plates.caption: Visible chain-of-thought captured alongside the answer; one of the five models that quarantined the flagged items.

plates.title: Run 10 · Mistral Small 4, via Duck.ai
plates.caption: The invented retrieval mechanism offered as corroboration, beside its own concession that it answers confidently when uncertain.

plates.title: Run 11 · Gemma 4 31B, via Duck.ai
plates.caption: The most restrained answer of the thirteen; raised prompt-engineering variance as missing context.

plates.title: Run 13a · Namazu, the live session
plates.caption: THE LOAD-BEARING FRAME. Two collapsed reasoning headers, and between them the assistant line “I’ll search for context…”. Evidence for three of the four statements in “The trace is not a log”, and for Correction Eight.

plates.title: Run 13b · Namazu, the delivered answer
plates.caption: Recovered after the session appeared to stall; it had in fact completed. The opening paragraph is the fourth statement: no independent access to either source.

plates.title: Run 14a · Deepshi Flash 2.0
plates.caption: Right of reply and Q1. Item 2 is the verification-note quarantine; the Q1 answer carries the G2 sampling concern.

plates.title: Run 14b · Deepshi Flash 2.0, Q3 and Q4
plates.caption: The only structured impact-versus-control table in the run, including “the confidence is in the fluency, not in a verified truth-tracking mechanism”.

plates.title: Run 14c · Deepshi Flash 2.0, Q4 and summary
plates.caption: The closing summary table. The model states its own training cutoff as January 2025, against a record dated September 2026.
